name: Neo-Brutalism UI
summary: Flat, loud colour fields with thick black borders and hard, unblurred offset shadows. It grew from product sites such as Gumroad and from Figma community kits as a deliberate reply to corporate softness.

philosophy.core_thesis: An interface earns trust by showing its structure openly and being loud about it, because every border and shadow is a stated fact.
design_principles: Draw a solid #000000 border of 2px to 4px around every card, button, input and image.
Cast one hard shadow with zero blur, offset 4px 4px, for example 4px 4px 0 0 #000000, on every raised element.
Fill surfaces with flat saturated colour at 100% opacity, and use two to four loud hues on one page.
On hover, move the element by the shadow offset and cut the shadow to 0, so that it appears to press into the page.
Use radii of 0px to 8px only, and use the same value on all elements of one page.
Set headings in a heavy grotesque or mono face at weight 700 or higher, in sizes from 48px to 96px.
Keep text black on colour fields, and reach at least 7:1 contrast on every fill.
anti_patterns: Blurred drop shadows with a blur radius above 0px
Subtle grey gradients or glossy highlights on surfaces
Pastel, low-saturation fills with grey text
Hairline 1px borders or borders in a colour other than black
Mixed corner radii on one page, such as 4px on cards and 24px on buttons
Thin font weights below 500 for headings

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px to 32px gutters and cards that sit in blocks of 2, 3 or 4 columns; the offset shadow adds 4px to 8px of visual width.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25–40% of the surface is open; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 32, 48 and 64px, and a card has 24px padding.
layout.alignment_rules: Left-aligned text; blocks sit on grid edges with a slight tilt of 1 to 2 degrees allowed on stickers and badges only; sections are cut by full-width 3px black rules.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px to 8px radius, a 3px black border and a 4px 4px 0 0 #000000 shadow; pills use a 999px radius only for tags.

font_pairings.note: Quirky grotesque headlines over a plain text face.
Heavy poster-weight display for large headings.
Condensed, high-contrast display with a neutral body.
Monospace labels for a raw, technical voice.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.03em; body stays at 0; upper-case labels take +0.05em.
hierarchy_rules: Use weight 700 or 800 for headings and 400 or 500 for body; skip the light weights.
Set headings at 48px to 96px and body at 16px to 18px, a ratio of about 3:1 or higher.
Set buttons and labels in bold upper case at 14px with +0.05em tracking.
Put the key word of a headline on a colour highlight block with a 3px black border.

color.palette_structure: Black outlines, a warm off-white or yellow page and two to four loud flat hues such as pink, blue and green, each at 100% opacity and used in large blocks.
color.contrast_rules: Black text on every loud fill reaches at least 7:1, for example 15:1 on Lemon and 7:1 on Electric Blue; white text is allowed only on black fills; the 3px black border gives each control a 21:1 edge.
color.surface_treatment: Flat opaque fields at 100% opacity with no gradient, no texture and no transparency; an optional dot or grid pattern at 8% black on the page background.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source is simulated; a hard offset shadow of 4px 4px 0 0 #000000 falls to the bottom right with zero blur, and it works as an outline extension.

materiality.surface_simulation: None; the surface is flat cut paper or sticker stock with a black outline and a hard drop, and it imitates no real material.
materiality.border_rules: Solid #000000 borders of 2px on small controls, 3px on cards and 4px on hero blocks; the border colour never changes between states.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Blur is 0px everywhere; elevation is the shadow offset: 2px 2px on tags, 4px 4px on cards and buttons, 8px 8px on modals, all in #000000.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Bold icons with a 2.5px to 3px stroke and square or round caps at 24px, in black, often inside a coloured circle with a 2px border.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Flat illustration in the loud palette with thick black outlines, plus stickers, stars and arrows; hand-drawn marks are welcome.

motion.transition_physics: Elements translate by exactly the shadow offset on hover and press, so that the shadow appears to collapse; the move is short, linear in feel and without overshoot.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover moves the element 4px right and 4px down and sets the shadow to 0 0 0 0; active keeps that position; focus adds a 3px solid #4D7CFF outline offset by 2px.

emotion.target_response: Direct energy: the viewer feels that the brand is honest, a little rebellious and not afraid of being seen.

avoid_when: The brand must signal quiet luxury, medical care or banking security.
The interface is a dense enterprise tool, because 3px borders and 4px shadows consume space on every row.
The audience expects a native platform look, such as an OS settings screen.

modifiers.how: Cut the border to 1px, remove the offset shadow and mute the fills to 60% saturation; keep the flat fields and the grid.
Cut the palette to black, white and one red, set a 0px radius and flush-left text on a 12-column grid; keep the 2px rules.
Pack the content into a rectangular grid of mixed-size cells with a 16px gap; keep the 3px border and the hard shadow.
Move to an 8px radius, a 1px border and a soft shadow of 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); keep one loud accent.

pack.why: A heavy line with a blunt weight that matches the thick borders.
